It is recorded again through `.harness-drafts/round8.sh`, which declares both the model and the agent, because checks 322 and 323 were recorded by hand without `--agent` and an entry citing them passed only while `[routing] shadow` is true: with it off, `_require_the_strictest_route_in_the_plan` would refuse a pair already in the journal, which is what SEEN-138's replay of finished tickets would read back. The sixth review's F34. The fifth review passed and recorded seven findings; these are its three medium ones, all three in the rules this ticket exists to deliver rather than in the account of them. `dependency-cruiser/core-no-io` anchors the bare specifier as its three sibling deny-lists in the same file already do, so the money core cannot import an IO library that is not installed yet: a specifier resolves to a `node_modules` path once the package is installed and to the bare name while it is not, which is the state of six of its seven libraries here. The seventh is `pg`, a declared dependency of `packages/core`, and a `packages/core` import of it was refused before the anchoring as well as after, because under pnpm's layout the specifier resolves from the importing package and not from the repository root, which is where the measurement behind the earlier version of this sentence was taken. Six of the seven were silent, not seven, and the clause was carrying one library rather than nothing: a reader who took the `node_modules/` half of the alternation for dead weight and simplified the pattern to the bare names would stop refusing the one library of the seven this repository has installed, with both of that round's tests still green. Record 343 is the correction and the sixth review's F29 is the finding. `ast-grep/money-as-integer-cents` reads the object property and the class field a fee schedule and a tariff are written in, beside the variable declarator it already read, which are the two shapes SEEN-016 and SEEN-071 will write and the two the rule's own registry entry had been promising. And the one test that executes the staged run rather than reading it is named as a step in the CI job that installs the workspace, where before it skipped in every job: the job that runs the harness suite installs nothing and the jobs that install never ran the suite, so F21's fix was guarded in CI by two substring assertions over the script's text.
